description: A consensus-developed framework defining 22 head and neck surgery competencies for general surgery residents and fellows, intended to guide curriculum development and training standardization.

description: An open-access nursing education package developed by Salami Oluwabukola et al.
title: A-CHARM project

title: A Monte Carlo stochastic simulator of student academic performance along a university curriculum

description: A nine-area map of the knowledge, skills, and attitudes required for psychosocial care in adult and older adult acute mental health inpatient settings, developed by Wood et al.
